notes:
November 25th 2026
Version 13.18.17 (stable) / 13.19.17 (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Score: fast runs written as 32nds. (K,R)
* Audio Editor runs smoother. (K,R)
* FR-4X: restore a .UPA over USB. (R)
* Choose the accordion's MIDI port. (R)
* Quit no longer stops at editors. (K,R)
* FR-8X: Write/Save safe while a list plays. (R)
* See Help->Show Release Notes for More...
notes_beta:
November 26th 2026
Version 13.18.18 (stable) / 13.19.18 (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Score: 32nds play exactly as written. (K,R)
* Clearer Metronome and Level menus. (K,R)
* Audio Editor: each take keeps its own files. (K,R)
* Apply keeps the settings you didn't touch. (R)
* FR-4X: fewer flash writes on Layout sends. (R)
* No backup asked when importing into an Empty slot. (R)
* See Help->Show Release Notes for More...

November 25th 2026
Version 13.18.16 (stable) / 13.19.16 (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Large USB drives now listed. (K,R)
* FISA: Del marks scenes Empty; multi-scene copy. (K)
* .UPL: oversized drops ask first. (R)
* Audio Editor: ● stops; Ctrl+Z discards. (K,R)
